question: Can native Cano geometry deterministically materialize readable perception meshes for one fixed train-only sentinel from every frozen V2R recipe before a full 100-parent mesh batch?
method: Verify the sealed V2R and V2 evidence, then select only accepted_rank_in_recipe=1 from each of ten recipes. Independently reconstruct each frozen parent twice from its topology seed and bounded draw stream, require exact graph/spline/operation identity, reset to its predeclared geometry seed, draw one FTA value in [-2,-1] m, run upstream random point-cloud parameters and default native Poisson meshing exactly once, and compare primary/replay effective parameters and OBJ SHA-256. Audit mesh arrays, axis coverage, AABB coverage and component concentration; render exactly ten complete primary train maps. Do not read or render validation/development-test parents and create no LiDAR, labels or training data.
baseline: The five explicit-template CPU pilot produced readable native perception meshes, but the frozen random parents span 586.797 to 2980.408 m and exact geometry replay was not tested. M0 covers ten preselected train-only recipe sentinels totaling 15.192 km before any multi-GiB full batch.

user_authorization.scope: One M0 implementation and execution with ten fixed C01 train sentinels, one primary and one exact replay native perception mesh each, ten complete train previews, no retries/replacements, no validation/development-test inspection and no LiDAR, labels or training.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续吧那 after receiving the completed V2R summary and exact M0 scope.

acceptance_criteria: Approved proposal/card, exact frozen tool set, fixed Cano checkout, E1 identity, all frozen source files, 17/17 V2R evidence and 391/391 V2 evidence match before RUNNING.
Exactly ten predeclared accepted-rank-1 train parents are selected; no validation or development-test parent is read, rendered or used for adaptation.
All twenty independent topology reconstructions match their frozen graph, spline, parent and operation-trace identities before meshing.

Exactly ten primary and ten replay native meshes are generated using only their reserved geometry seeds, one FTA draw, upstream random point-cloud parameters and default mesh parameters, with zero retry, replacement or repair.

All meshes are finite, nonempty, index-valid and free of degenerate triangles; every source tunnel has finite positive-radius axis rows, all splines lie within mesh AABB plus 10 m and the largest triangle component fraction is at least 0.999.
All ten primary-replay pairs have identical effective geometry parameters and exact OBJ SHA-256.
Exactly ten complete primary train maps and no validation/development-test preview are produced for human review.
Output remains within 3600 seconds and 1.5 GiB; LiDAR, labels, formal data, training, models, trajectories, simulators and M-TARE changes remain zero.
stop_conditions: Any approval, frozen tool, source seal, source file, E1, fixed checkout, free-disk, run-state or scope mismatch
Any frozen topology or operation trace fails exact reconstruction before meshing
Any mesh generation, array, axis, AABB, component or exact-replay criterion fails
Continuation would require a new seed, parameter redraw, spare parent, mesh repair, component deletion, changed threshold or validation/development-test inspection
The executor exceeds 3600 seconds or the result exceeds 1.5 GiB
expected_evidence: Frozen source/tool/environment/approval identities, exact command, log, duration, RUN_STATE and evidence SHA-256
Twenty immutable materialization directories with mesh OBJ, axis NPY, exact graph/splines, effective geometry parameters and mesh audit
Ten parent metrics, aggregate manifest and summary proving topology identity, mesh quality and exact replay
Ten complete train-only X-Y/X-Z maps with machine-readable provenance and zero validation/development-test preview
Explicit zero LiDAR, label, formal-data, training, model, trajectory, simulator and M-TARE counts

estimated_cost.compute: Frozen E1 CPU; twenty sequential native Cano Poisson mesh materializations over ten fixed train sentinels totaling 15.192 km per primary/replay pass; no raycasting, simulator or training.
